comment: In-app events (asc.py push-app-event; docs/asc.md «События в App Store»). Limits: name 30, shortDescription 50, longDescription 120 characters; an event runs 31 days at most and is shown up to 14 days before it starts; times in UTC (Almaty is UTC+5). en-GB carries the Russian texts (D9). The art comes from scripts/compose_event_art.py. Free events: purchaseRequirement NO_COST_ASSOCIATED.
